WITH budget_totals AS (
  SELECT b.budget_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
         COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
  FROM budget b
  LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
avg_spend AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM budget_totals
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT bt.total_cost, bt.expense_count
  FROM budget_totals bt, avg_spend a
  WHERE bt.total_cost > a.avg_total
)
SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_above_total,
       SUM(expense_count) AS total_expenses,
       AVG(total_cost) - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_spend) AS avg_excess_over_average
FROM above_avg;
